limits: Records cover federal, statewide, legislative, judicial and local offices; local coverage varies by source.
Official-list status applies only to names read from an election-office general list. Other November records are current roster listings or provider associations.
Federal provider records absent from refreshed rosters retain their original dates but have an unconfirmed label; absence is not treated as withdrawal.
FEC filings, earlier election dates and profiles with no confirmed office are separately labelled.
ZIP areas and boundary intersections do not establish a complete personal ballot. Verify with your official election office.
Finance figures retain the FEC reporting period and can include transfers between committees.

Candidate–advertiser links use a reported Facebook page ID, an exact unique normalized name and affiliation within one state, or an exact Meta disclaimer matched to an FEC authorised committee and one 2026 candidate ID. The match is shown; other advertisers are not attributed to a candidate.

Reported funder names match a unique FEC committee registry entry only when the normalized disclaimer is exact. PACs and party committees are not assigned to candidates through this lookup. Registration does not establish current activity.

Unclassified Meta accounts may receive separately labelled inferred affiliations. Declared funder matches do not establish candidate ownership; opposition and monitoring pages remain separate. Scores are evidence strength, not calibrated authentication probabilities.
